_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: 16-digit numeric string, unique across the database

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

app.description: Application context of the document: Auto = automotive caliper MES, Gamp = pharmaceutical GMP, Common = reference data shared by both

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

parentWipUnitId.description: Reference to u_mes_plan_wipUnit._id: parent wip unit

parentWipUnitName.description: Display value of parentWipUnitId, copied from u_mes_plan_wipUnit.recordNo

parentSerialNumberId.description: Reference to u_mes_trac_serialNumber._id: parent serial number

parentSerialNumberName.description: Display value of parentSerialNumberId, copied from u_mes_trac_serialNumber.recordNo

parentItemName.description: Display value of parentItemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

childItemName.description: Display value of childItemId, copied from u_mes_prod_item.description

childLotName.description: Display value of childLotId, copied from u_mes_plan_lot.recordNo

unitOfMeasureName.description: Display value of unitOfMeasureId, copied from u_mes_mast_unitOfMeasure.name

operationName.description: Display value of operationId, copied from u_mes_prod_operation.name

operationExecutionName.description: Display value of operationExecutionId, copied from u_mes_plan_operationExecution.recordNo

materialConsumptionName.description: Display value of materialConsumptionId, copied from u_mes_matl_materialConsumption.recordNo

linkedAt.description: Date and time when the record was linked. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

linkedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user recorded for 'linked'

linkedBy.description: Display name of the user in linkedById, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

removedAt.description: Date and time when the record was removed. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

childSerialNumberId.description: Reference to u_mes_trac_serialNumber._id: child serial number

childSerialNumberName.description: Display value of childSerialNumberId, copied from u_mes_trac_serialNumber.recordNo

childWipUnitId.description: Reference to u_mes_plan_wipUnit._id: child wip unit

childWipUnitName.description: Display value of childWipUnitId, copied from u_mes_plan_wipUnit.recordNo

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update. Datetime field: local plant time (IST) stored with the +0000 suffix

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
